2027 Summer Analyst - Investment Banking
Harborview Partners
New York, NY

Harborview Partners is a leading independent investment bank advising companies on mergers and acquisitions, capital raising and restructuring.

As a Summer Analyst you will:
- Build financial models, including DCF, LBO and comparable companies analyses.
- Prepare pitch books and client presentations for senior bankers.
- Support due diligence and deal execution on live sell-side and buy-side transactions.
- Research industries, companies and market trends.

What we look for:
- Undergraduates graduating in 2028 with a strong academic record.
- Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; interest in financial markets.
- Strong work ethic, attention to detail and ability to work under pressure on tight deadlines.

Harborview Partners is an equal opportunity employer.
